description: This file defines an abstract class 'PurePayload' implementing 'PayloadInterface'. It manages payload data with properties like uuid, content, timestamps, and sync info, and includes methods for ejecting data and abstract copy methods.

classes.name: PurePayload
classes.description: An abstract class representing a generic payload with properties for content, timestamps, sync info, and methods for cloning and ejecting data.

methods.name: ejected
methods.description: Returns a comprehensive object representing the payload data suitable for transfer or storage.

methods.name: serverUpdatedAt
methods.description: Getter for the last update date of the payload.

methods.name: serverUpdatedAtTimestamp
methods.description: Getter for the timestamp of the last update.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Abstract method to create a copy of the payload with optional overrides.

methods.name: copyAsSyncResolved
methods.description: Abstract method to create a sync-resolved copy of the payload.
